description: This Java class defines a service component in a Spring application responsible for querying product data from the repository and returning a list of product summaries. It includes dependency injection, transaction management, logging, and a method for retrieving active products ordered by name.

classes.name: ProductQueryService
classes.description: Spring service class that provides methods to query product data, particularly listing active products.

methods.name: listActiveProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of active products from the product repository, transforms them into DTOs, and returns the list. The method is transactional with read-only access.
